subject: bell-shaped prism whale
pose: 三分之二正面，尾鳍前卷
requested_medium: frosted glass and stone studio render
art_direction: 小鲸身体像磨砂玻璃铃，内部包着橘色石芯，尾鳍向前卷出环形姿态。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a whale-like creature shaped like a small frosted-glass bell, with a warm orange stone core visible inside. Two broad translucent fins hang from its sides, and a thick tail curls forward into an incomplete ring beneath the body. Give it a calm, slightly proud face etched shallowly into the glass, avoiding anatomical realism. View it from a low three-quarter angle against a muted violet field. Use controlled refraction, cloudy glass thickness, and a matte mineral core; avoid rainbow dispersion, jewelry sparkle, and a watery environment. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
